description: Admin Dashboard UI — 6 pages with Enterprise Information System design. Depends on FEAT-001 (design tokens, deps) and FEAT-002 (API routes exist). Independent of FEAT-004 (public page). Read UI_DESIGN_INTELLIGENCE.md at /Users/macbookpro/Downloads/UI_Design_Intelligence_Pack/UI_DESIGN_INTELLIGENCE.md before writing any UI code.
steps: Read /Users/macbookpro/Downloads/UI_Design_Intelligence_Pack/UI_DESIGN_INTELLIGENCE.md and /Users/macbookpro/Downloads/UI_Design_Intelligence_Pack/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md before writing any component. The design direction is already decided: Enterprise Information System, deep navy #1e3a5f, white backgrounds, Inter font stack, no glassmorphism, no gradients, no decorative blobs, no fake charts.

Implement Tailwind design tokens. In tailwind.config.ts extend theme with colors: brand:'#1e3a5f', brandHover:'#2d5a8e', accent:'#2563eb', bgPage:'#f8f9fa', surface:'#ffffff', textPrimary:'#111827', textSecondary:'#6b7280', border:'#e5e7eb', success:'#15803d', successBg:'#dcfce7', warning:'#b45309', warningBg:'#fef9c3', danger:'#dc2626', dangerBg:'#fee2e2', info:'#1d4ed8', infoBg:'#dbeafe'. In src/app/globals.css add @import url for Inter from Google Fonts (https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap) and set font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui on body. Set base font-size 14px for data density.

Build src/components/ui/Button.tsx: variants prop (primary|secondary|danger|ghost), size prop (sm|md|lg), loading prop (shows spinner, disables button), disabled prop. Primary: bg-brand text-white hover:bg-brandHover. Secondary: border border-border bg-surface hover:bg-bgPage. Danger: bg-danger text-white. Ghost: transparent hover:bg-bgPage. All variants have focus-visible ring. Keyboard accessible. Loading state: show lucide Loader2 icon spinning, aria-disabled=true.

Build src/components/ui/Input.tsx: props: label, name, error, helperText, required, all standard input props. Always renders associated <label>. Error text in text-danger with role=alert. Helper text in text-secondary. Focus ring uses --color-accent.
Build src/components/ui/Select.tsx: same props pattern as Input but renders <select>. Native select for accessibility and zero extra dependencies.

Build src/components/ui/Badge.tsx: status prop typed as DocumentStatus. ISSUED: bg-successBg text-success border border-success, text '✓ Issued'. REVOKED: bg-dangerBg text-danger, text '✗ Revoked'. EXPIRED: bg-warningBg text-warning, text '⚠ Expired'. DRAFT: bg-gray-100 text-gray-600, text '○ Draft'. Never uses color alone — always text label. aria-label includes status name.

Build src/components/ui/DataTable.tsx: generic TypeScript component. Props: columns (header, accessor, sortable?), data, totalCount, page, pageSize, onPageChange, onSort, isLoading, emptyMessage. Renders <table> with <thead>/<tbody>. Loading: show skeleton rows (3 rows with animate-pulse). Empty: centered message in a <td> spanning all columns. Pagination: prev/next buttons + 'Page X of Y'. Sortable headers show lucide ArrowUpDown icon. All th have scope='col'.
Build src/components/ui/PageHeader.tsx: props: title (h1), subtitle (optional p), action (optional ReactNode slot). title is h1 with text-textPrimary text-xl font-semibold. Clean divider below.
Build src/components/ui/Card.tsx: simple wrapper div with bg-surface border border-border rounded-sm p-4. Use ONLY when grouping genuinely improves comprehension — not decoratively.

Build src/components/ui/Dialog.tsx: accessible modal. Uses React portal. Props: isOpen, onClose, title, children. Focus trap (tab cycles within dialog). Escape key closes. aria-modal=true, role=dialog, aria-labelledby={titleId}. Backdrop click closes. Smooth fade-in (CSS transition, respects prefers-reduced-motion).

Build src/components/ui/Toast.tsx: notification component. Props: message, type (success|error|info|warning), onDismiss. Fixed position bottom-right. Auto-dismisses after 4s. role=status for success/info, role=alert for error/warning.

Build src/components/layout/AdminLayout.tsx: persistent left sidebar (240px) + main content area. Sidebar: app name 'WSS QR Signature' in text-brand font-semibold at top, nav items with lucide icons: Dashboard (/admin, LayoutDashboard), Issuances (/admin/issuances, FileText), New Issuance (/admin/issuances/new, PlusCircle), Settings (/admin/settings, Settings). Active state: bg-bgPage text-brand border-l-2 border-brand. User email + Sign Out at sidebar bottom. Mobile: sidebar hidden, hamburger menu shows drawer. Content area: p-6 bg-bgPage min-h-screen.

Build src/app/sign-in/page.tsx and src/app/sign-in/SignInForm.tsx: centered card (max-w-sm mx-auto mt-20), app logo/name at top, email + password Input components, sign-in Button (full width, loading state during auth). On auth failure show error 'Invalid email or password.' without revealing which field is wrong. On success redirect to /admin. Use next-auth signIn('credentials', {...}) client action. No hero, no gradient, no decorative elements.

Build src/app/admin/page.tsx (Dashboard): server component. Fetch real counts from DB: total issued (status=ISSUED), total revoked (status=REVOKED), issued this month, total all records. Render 4 stat cards (Card component): each has a number and label. NO fake charts. NO fake activity feed. Quick action button: 'New Issuance' → /admin/issuances/new. Recent 5 issuances table (title, status badge, date) with links to detail pages.

Build src/app/admin/issuances/new/page.tsx and IssuanceForm.tsx: form with all fields from roadmap: title (required), docNumber (required), docType (required, select: Surat Keputusan/Surat Tugas/Sertifikat/Memo/Other), description (textarea), orgId (required, select populated from GET /api/organizations), unitId (select, populated when org selected), signerId (required, select populated from signers), docDate (date input, required), issuanceTimestamp (datetime-local, required), adminNotes (textarea, optional). Client-side Zod validation with field-level errors shown below inputs. Duplicate check: on docNumber blur, fetch GET /api/issuances?docNumber=X&orgId=Y — if results found, show warning banner 'A document with this number already exists for this organization.' Submit button shows loading state. On success: redirect to /admin/issuances/[id].

Build src/app/admin/issuances/[id]/page.tsx, IssuanceActions.tsx, AuditTimeline.tsx: page fetches full issuance by DB id. Display all fields in a structured layout (2-column grid on desktop, 1-column on mobile). Status badge prominently at top. Action bar below status (buttons depend on status): DRAFT shows: 'Issue Document' (primary button, triggers POST /api/issuances/[id]/issue with loading state), 'Edit' (secondary), 'Delete' (danger, confirmation dialog). ISSUED shows: 'Download PNG' (triggers GET /api/issuances/[id]/assets/[assetId]), 'Copy Verification URL' (copies {BASE_URL}/verify/{ref} to clipboard, show toast), 'View Public Page' (new tab), 'Revoke' (danger button, opens Dialog with reason textarea required min 10 chars). REVOKED shows: revocation info, 'View History', 'New Issuance from this Record' (creates new draft pre-filled). Below actions: PNG signature block preview (img tag pointing to asset API, only for ISSUED/REVOKED). AuditTimeline: last 10 AuditEvents for this issuanceId, shown as a vertical list with timestamp, actor, and action description.

Build src/app/admin/issuances/page.tsx, IssuanceTable.tsx, IssuanceFilters.tsx: server component with URL param hydration. IssuanceFilters: search input (text), status select, orgId select, dateFrom/dateTo date inputs, sort select. Filters update URL query params using router.push (no page reload, preserve history). IssuanceTable: DataTable component with columns: Title, Doc Number, Signer, Organization, Status (Badge), Date. Each row has View link to /admin/issuances/[id]. Pagination from API total count. Empty state: 'No issuances match your filters.' with clear-filters link.

Build src/app/admin/settings/page.tsx, OrgForm.tsx, LogoUpload.tsx: OrgForm edits org name, address, website with PATCH /api/organizations/[id]. LogoUpload: file input accepting image/png image/jpeg image/svg+xml, max 2MB. Client-side pre-validation: check file.type and file.size before sending. On success show logo preview. Show notice: 'Updating the logo does not retroactively change previously generated signature blocks. Re-issue documents to update them.'
acceptance_criteria: Sign-in page renders, submitting valid credentials redirects to /admin
Dashboard shows real DB counts (not hardcoded numbers)
New Issuance form validates all required fields client-side and shows field-level errors
Issuance detail page shows correct action buttons for each status (DRAFT/ISSUED/REVOKED)
Archive page filters change the displayed rows and sync to URL query params
No fake charts, no fake activity feeds, no decorative blobs or gradient heroes anywhere
All icon-only buttons have accessible names (aria-label)
Anti-AI-Slop score self-assessment >= 42/50 (product specificity >= 4, functional completeness >= 4, accessibility >= 4)
findings: 1. Next.js 16 enforces `export const instant = false` on all admin pages that use DB queries or auth() — added to all 4 admin pages and sign-in page. 2. `new Date()` in server components triggers prerender error in Next.js 16; fixed by using `connection()` from next/server in DashboardStats.tsx. 3. React Compiler ESLint rule flags `ref` as special — renamed IssuanceActions prop from `ref` to `issuanceRef`. 4. React Compiler flags synchronous setState in useEffect early-return path — restructured IssuanceForm to use async function. 5. `fileRef.current` accessed during render flagged — replaced with `hasFile` state flag in LogoUpload. 6. Pre-existing `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` in signature-block-generator.ts needed per-line eslint-disable (file-level disable was removed by earlier tooling update). All three verification commands pass: npm run build ✓, npm run typecheck ✓, npm run lint ✓ (0 errors, 37 warnings all in pre-existing FEAT-002 lib files). Files created: 10 UI components, 6 admin pages with server/client split, 4 new API routes (org detail, org units CRUD, org signers). Anti-AI-Slop assessment: Product specificity 5/5 (all copy references QR issuances, orgs, signers), Functional completeness 4/5 (all controls wired to real API), Accessibility 4/5 (proper labels, focus states, dialog focus trap, ARIA), no fake data, no decorative blobs or gradients. Score: 44/50.
